# get_web_browser_settings()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.get_web_browser_settings`

## Signature

```python
async def get_web_browser_settings() -> 'types.WebBrowserSettings': ...
```

## Documentation

Get the settings of the web browser used to open links.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Returns

[`WebBrowserSettings`](../../types/user_and_chats/WebBrowserSettings.md): On success, the web browser settings are returned.

### Example

```python
settings = await app.get_web_browser_settings()
print(settings.open_external_browser)
```
